title: BiFe0.5Cr0.5O3 nanocatalysts for sustainable solar-light-driven purification of pharmaceutical wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16241-16256
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01638J, Paper
Open Access

Titas Vincent Rozario, Mohasin Tarek, M. A. Basith
Solar-driven BiFe0.5Cr0.5O3 nanocatalysts efficiently degrade antibiotics via enhanced charge separation, oxygen vacancies, and ROS generation, offering a stable, visible-light-active solution for pharmaceutical wastewater purification.
